name: kramers_escape_arrhenius_classical
divergence_log: Classical Kramers rate assumes a real trajectory crossing a potential barrier via thermal activation. The quantum analog includes tunneling contributions that make the rate finite as T -> 0 (where classical r -> 0) and admits complex instanton / WKB corrections invisible to Arrhenius. This baseline cannot encode tunneling or coherent splittings.
